story.headline: About 800,000 Colorado ballots wrongly include the Front Range Passenger Rail tax question
story.summary: About 800,000 ballots in Adams, Arapahoe, Douglas and Weld counties include Issue 7A, a proposed sales tax for Front Range Passenger Rail, though those voters live outside the rail district and can't vote on it. A joint statement from the state and the county clerks' association said the rail district didn't adequately tell counties about its updated boundaries after a 2026 law change. The district apologized to the clerks, and the Secretary of State said only eligible votes on 7A will be counted.

quote.text: The Front Range Passenger Rail District apologized in a letter to the four county clerks offices for a lack of communication that led to the error.
